name: @coploy/ots-contract
description: OTS — Open Talent Standard: schemas normativos (JSON Schema 2020-12) e contrato do plugin de motor de entrevista

scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):e.name.endsWith('.json')?[path.join(d,e.name)]:[]);for(const d of ['0.1','0.2']){for(const f of walk(d)){JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'))}}console.log('json ok')"
